Good morning, Mohammed,

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. We completely understand how important it is to have a smooth and hassle-free check-in experience.

As mentioned earlier, the check-in form needs to be completed before your arrival so that we can submit your details to the building community in advance and avoid any delays or inconvenience at the time of check-in.

We truly appreciate your kind cooperation and understanding, and we apologize once again for any inconvenience caused.

Thank you so much.
